This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Dethro Glok]] was a member of this species.<ref name="EIR" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|mottled orange]] skin, enlarged [[Bone/Legends|craniums]], large brows covered in black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], bulging [[Nose/Legends|noses]], and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with red irises.<ref name="EIR" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Dethro Glok]], served as the ruler of a group of scrap dealers who scavenged the abandoned mines and gas refineries of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Ibanna]], designing a number of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses across the gas giant, including [[Scrapper's Run/Legends|Scrapper's Run]], [[Dethro's Revenge/Legends|Dethro's Revenge]], and [[Abyss (Ord Ibanna)|Abyss]]<ref name="EIR" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref>
